newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares ease in sluggish summer trade.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares ease in sluggish summer trade.

text.p: Latvian shares eased on Friday as activity almost ground to a halt, with only 27,000 lats worth of shares changing hands and the Rietumu index shedding 0.5 percent to 151.64. The bourse index fell 2.72 points to 382.20.
The four shares quoted from the five-stock official list all eased. Riga Transport Fleet fell the most , dropping 1.7 percent to 1.15 lats in trade of only 200 lats.
Dealers said the fleet was not expected to fall much more as its price was beginning to look like a bargain and its six-month results, due out at the end of July, are expected to be good.
The Riga Shipyard lost a santime to 1.27 lats in trade of 8,000 lats and dealers said it could fall further as employees were expected to sell free shares ahead of their summer holidays.
